name: MIDNIGHT SNACK
source:
Poor Sam woke up hungry in the middle of the night! Help a guy out!

He got kicked out of his parents house a while ago and has been living in a new place for like a month, but turns out the place is haunted??!¿?? No wonder it's so cheap! Lucky him! It's a bit creepy but his (pretty) roomate makes it less creepy.

Anyway he's hungry so he has to get up and snack on something... unless that "something" snacks on him?

[From [url=https://areqreepy.itch.io/midnight-snack]itch.io[/url]]
